summary: Crash when clicking "Presets" after setting the superflat preset with a non-existent biome
description: Crash when you click "Presets" after replacing the "minecraft:plains" to a non-existent biome in the superflat customization menu I was creating a world called "Nether" with Superflat, I replaced "minecraft:plains" to "minecraft:the_nether" to see if the piglins won t turn to zombified piglins, I clicked "Done" and clicked "Presets" again to see if "minecraft:the_nether" doesn t has turn onto "minecraft:plains" again, and The Game Crashed What I expected to happen was: When I click presets after replacing it, it should resets to default. What happened was: It crashed after I press presets. How to reproduce: Create a new world in Superflat click on Customize, after click on Presets replace the biome from "minecraft:plains" to a non-existent biome in the superflat customization menu after click on Done and Presets again and see if it crash(If you press cancel it won t crash)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new world in Superflat mode.
3. Click on "Customize".
4. Click on "Presets".
5. Replace the biome from "minecraft:plains" to a non-existent biome in the superflat customization menu.
6. Click "Done".
7. Click "Presets" again.
8. Observe that the game crashes.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.16.2, 1.16.3 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.3, 1.16.4 Pre-release 1, 1.16.4 Pre-release 2, 1.16.4 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.4
Observed Behavior: When attempting to click on the "Presets" button after modifying the superflat preset to include a non-existent biome, specifically replacing "minecraft:plains" with "minecraft:the_nether," the game crashes instead of resetting to the default preset. The expected behavior is that clicking "Presets" would revert the biome selection back to the default plains biome, but instead, the game encounters an error and shuts down. To reproduce this issue, one must create a new world in the Superflat mode, navigate to the customization menu, and replace the existing biome with a non-existent one. After clicking "Done" and then "Presets" again, the crash occurs. Notably, if the player cancels the action instead of proceeding to "Presets," the game does not crash, indicating that the issue specifically arises from the attempt to access the presets after making the biome change.
Expected Behavior: When clicking "Presets" after customizing the superflat world settings, the game should revert the biome selection back to the default "minecraft:plains" without crashing. Instead of experiencing a crash, the player should see the preset options displayed correctly, allowing them to verify or adjust their biome choice. This behavior should be consistent across all versions of the game, ensuring a smooth user experience when customizing superflat worlds.
